#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Tuple {
    long long d;
    int x, y, z;
    Tuple(long long d, int x, int y, int z) : d(d), x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
};

class InputReader {
public:
    std::istream& stream;
    std::vector<char> buf;
    int curChar, numChars;

    InputReader(std::istream& s) : stream(s), buf(1024), curChar(0), numChars(0) {}

    int read() {
        if (numChars == -1) throw std::runtime_error("Unknown error");
        if (curChar >= numChars) {
            curChar = 0;
            numChars = stream.readsome(buf.data(), buf.size());
            if (numChars <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buf[curChar++];
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return std::stoi(next());
    }

    std::string next() {
        int c = read();
        while (isSpaceChar(c)) c = read();
        std::string res;
        do {
            res += static_cast<char>(c);
            c = read();
        } while (!isSpaceChar(c));
        return res;
    }

private:
    bool isSpaceChar(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }
};

int main() {
    std::ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);
    InputReader in(std::cin);
    std::ostream& out = std::cout;

    const long long mod = 1000000007;
    const long long INF = (long long)1e18 + 1;
    long long nCr[100][100];

    int n = in.nextInt();
    int K = in.nextInt();

    int cnt50 = 0, cnt100 = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            if (j == 0 || j == i)
                nCr[i][j] = 1;
            else
                nCr[i][j] = (nCr[i - 1][j] + nCr[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod;
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int val = in.nextInt();
        if (val == 50) cnt50++;
        else cnt100++;
    }

    long long dist[200][200][2];
    long long dp[200][200][2];

    for (int i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 200; j++) {
            for (int z = 0; z < 2; z++) {
                dist[i][j][z] = INF;
            }
        }
    }

    dist[0][0][0] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 200; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < 200; j++)
            for (int z = 0; z < 2; z++)
                dp[i][j][z] = 0;

    dp[0][0][0] = 1;

    std::queue<Tuple> q;
    q.emplace(0, 0, 0, 0);

    while (!q.empty()) {
        Tuple t = q.front(); q.pop();
        int x = t.x, y = t.y, z = t.z;
        long long d = dist[x][y][z];

        if (z == 0) {
            int rem_x = cnt50 - x;
            int rem_y = cnt100 - y;
            for (int i = 0; i <= rem_x; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= rem_y; j++) {
                    if (i + j == 0) continue;
                    if (i * 50 + j * 100 > K) break;
                    int nx = x + i;
                    int ny = y + j;
                    int nz = z ^ 1;
                    if (dist[nx][ny][nz] >= d + 1) {
                        if (dist[nx][ny][nz] > d + 1) {
                            dist[nx][ny][nz] = d + 1;
                            q.emplace(dist[nx][ny][nz], nx, ny, nz);
                            long long val = (dp[x][y][z] * nCr[rem_x][i] % mod) * nCr[rem_y][j] % mod;
                            dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + val) % mod;
                        } else {
                            long long val = (dp[x][y][z] * nCr[rem_x][i] % mod) * nCr[rem_y][j] % mod;
                            dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + val) % mod;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            int rem_x = x;
            int rem_y = y;
            for (int i = 0; i <= rem_x; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= rem_y; j++) {
                    if (i + j == 0) continue;
                    if (i * 50 + j * 100 > K) break;
                    int nx = x - i;
                    int ny = y - j;
                    int nz = z ^ 1;
                    if (dist[nx][ny][nz] >= d + 1) {
                        if (dist[nx][ny][nz] > d + 1) {
                            dist[nx][ny][nz] = d + 1;
                            q.emplace(dist[nx][ny][nz], nx, ny, nz);
                            long long val = (dp[x][y][z] * nCr[rem_x][i] % mod) * nCr[rem_y][j] % mod;
                            dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + val) % mod;
                        } else {
                            long long val = (dp[x][y][z] * nCr[rem_x][i] % mod) * nCr[rem_y][j] % mod;
                            dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + val) % mod;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (dist[cnt50][cnt100][1] == INF) {
        out << -1 << "\n";
    } else {
        out << dist[cnt50][cnt100][1] << "\n";
    }
    out << dp[cnt50][cnt100][1] << "\n";

    return 0;
}
